REFUND POLICY

ARTICLE I. SCOPE
This policy applies to all customer refunds.

ARTICLE II. LIMITS
(a) Refunds above $500 need approval by a Finance Manager.
(b) Refunds to a card other than the original card are not allowed, except as provided in clause (d).
(c) Keep the records described in Article IV.
(d) A Finance Director may approve a refund to another card.

ARTICLE III. ESCALATION
Escalate disputes as set out in Article V.

ARTICLE IV. RECORDS
Keep refund records for 7 years.
